dossier_meta.subject: Graph Theory » Coloring » Edge coloring
dossier_meta.statement_text: Conjecture Every simple graph with maximum degree $ \Delta $ has a proper $ (\Delta+2) $ - edge-colouring so that every cycle contains edges of at least three distinct colours.
dossier_meta.context_text: An edge-colouring with the property that every cycle contains edges of at least three distinct colours is called an acyclic edge-colouring. It is known (see [AMR]) that every graph of maximum degree $ \Delta $ has an acyclic edge-colouring of size $ O(\Delta ) $ . The best upper bound so far is $ 4\Delta -4 $ and is due to Esperet and Parreau [EP]. It is also known (see [ASZ]) that this conjecture is true for graphs with girth at least $ C \Delta \log(\Delta ) $ (for some fixed constant $ C $ ).
